# Android/Quest build for the native mod (.so). This is cross-compiled with
# the Android NDK against headers restored by `qpm restore`.
#
# This relies on qpm's own generated qpm_defines.cmake / extern.cmake
# (regenerated by every `qpm restore`, not committed — see .gitignore) for
# the NDK toolchain setup, include paths, and per-dependency compile flags.
# That last part matters more than it looks: bs-cordl's own qpm.json
# declares it needs -fdeclspec -DUNITY_6 -DHAS_CODEGEN (its headers use
# __declspec(property(...)) throughout), and extern.cmake is what actually
# applies those — a hand-rolled include_directories()/target_link_libraries()
# CMakeLists.txt (an earlier version of this file) compiles most files fine
# but silently misses flags like that one. Using qpm's generated files is
# the standard convention every qpm-based Quest mod relies on.
#
# For a build that runs anywhere with just cmake+g++ (no NDK, no QPM), see
# tests/CMakeLists.txt, which builds only the engine-agnostic core library.
#
# Expected local build flow (see README.md for full setup):
#   qpm restore
#   ./build.sh
#   qpm qmod build   (or your qpm version's qmod-packaging command)

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)

# Sets MOD_ID, MOD_VERSION, COMPILE_ID, CODEGEN_ID, EXTERN_DIR, SHARED_DIR,
# the Android NDK/toolchain variables (must run before project()), and the
# RECURSE_FILES() macro extern.cmake uses below.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qpm_defines.cmake)

project(${COMPILE_ID})

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include_directories(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
include_directories(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/libs)

file(GLOB_RECURSE bs_editor_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/*.cpp)

add_library(${COMPILE_ID} SHARED ${bs_editor_sources})

target_compile_definitions(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE
    VERSION="${MOD_VERSION}"
    MOD_ID="${MOD_ID}"
)

target_compile_options(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE
    -Wall
    -Wextra
    -fexceptions
    -frtti
)

# Wires up every dependency's include paths and per-dependency compile
# options declared in their own qpm.json, and links extern/libs/*.so|*.a.
# Must come after add_library() above since it references ${COMPILE_ID}.
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/extern.cmake)

# beatsaber-hook's published .so deliberately compiles A64HookFunction
# with hidden visibility (so mods loaded together don't fight over one
# shared copy), so every consumer has to compile
# shared/inline-hook/And64InlineHook.cpp itself instead of linking it from
# the .so — INSTALL_HOOK calls it directly from a header template.
#
# This is glob'd here rather than via qpm.json's additionalData.extraFiles
# (the mechanism that normally exists for this): extraFiles tries to
# symlink shared/inline-hook a *second* time on top of the directory
# symlink that already exposes all of beatsaber-hook's shared/ tree
# (including inline-hook) as part of its normal headers, and the
# "File exists" fallback copy that follows resolves both sides of the
# copy to the same inode through the nested symlinks, silently truncating
# And64InlineHook.hpp/.cpp to 0 bytes (reproduced locally). Since these
# files are already present via the ordinary header restore, no qpm.json
# change is needed at all — just compile them.
file(GLOB bs_hook_inline_hook_sources
    ${EXTERN_DIR}/includes/beatsaber-hook/shared/inline-hook/*.cpp
    ${EXTERN_DIR}/includes/beatsaber-hook/shared/inline-hook/*.c
)
target_sources(${COMPILE_ID} PRIVATE ${bs_hook_inline_hook_sources})
